title: CSC14 robot telemetry
description: Live and historical telemetry of the CSC14 robot car (Pico W -> Mosquitto -> Node-RED -> PostgreSQL).

list.name: robot
list.label: Robot
list.query: SELECT robot_id FROM csc14.robot_link UNION SELECT robot_id FROM csc14.run ORDER BY 1
list.definition: robot ids seen by the backend

list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT 'all' AS __value, 'All data in the time range' AS __text, 1 AS o, now() AS s UNION ALL SELECT run_id::text, name || ' (' || to_char(started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || CASE WHEN ended_at IS NULL THEN ', active' ELSE '' END || ')', 2, started_at FROM csc14.run WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring}) x ORDER BY o, s DESC

current.text: All data in the time range

panels.title: Robot link (backend view)
panels.description: From the age of the newest heartbeat or telemetry: ONLINE <= 3 s, STALE <= 10 s, OFFLINE beyond (CSC14_STALE_AFTER_S / CSC14_OFFLINE_AFTER_S). UNKNOWN = the backend lost its broker connection, a backend problem rather than a robot fault. BACKEND NOT UPDATING = Node-RED stopped writing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN updated_at IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
	  WHEN now() - updated_at > interval '15 seconds' THEN 'BACKEND NOT UPDATING'
	  ELSE state END AS "link",
	  round(extract(epoch FROM now() - last_rx_at)::numeric, 1) AS "last frame (s ago)"
	FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN csc14.robot_link ON robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring}

panels.title: Operating mode
panels.description: Newest telemetry snapshot (500 ms). STALE = older than 5 s: not live.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((mode_label)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((mode_label)::text, '-') END AS "mode" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Critical fault active
panels.description: Newest snapshot: any active fault classed critical under the firmware policy flags (CSC14_SYS_*). LINE_RECOVERY is degraded, as in sys_state_logic.c.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((CASE WHEN critical THEN 'YES' ELSE 'no' END)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((CASE WHEN critical THEN 'YES' ELSE 'no' END)::text, '-') END AS "critical" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Backend pipeline
panels.description: Node-RED -> PostgreSQL health (csc14.ingest_health, every 10 s). Separate from robot faults.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN at IS NULL THEN 'NO DATA'
	  WHEN now() - at > interval '30 seconds' THEN 'NOT REPORTING'
	  WHEN broker_connected IS FALSE THEN 'BROKER DISCONNECTED'
	  WHEN queue_bulk + queue_priority > 100 THEN 'BUFFERING ' || (queue_bulk + queue_priority)
	  ELSE 'OK' END AS "backend", latency_p95_ms AS "write p95 (ms)"
	FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM csc14.ingest_health ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true

panels.title: Robot-reported link
panels.description: comm_state in the newest telemetry and the reconnect count in the newest heartbeat (4 bits, saturates at 15). Frames queued during an outage arrive later and show the outage states.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t."robot comm", h.reconnects AS "reconnects"
	FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((comm_state_label)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((comm_state_label)::text, '-') END AS "robot comm" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1) t
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT reconnects FROM csc14.heartbeat WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true

panels.title: Active faults (newest snapshot)
panels.description: Active fault bits from the newest telemetry snapshot. The first FAULTS event after the robot connects lists faults since boot, not active ones, so it is not used here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (SELECT fault_mask, received_at,
	    CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE snapshot' ELSE 'live' END AS freshness
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1)
	SELECT fb.bit, fb.name AS fault, fb.severity, fb.owner, t.freshness
	FROM t JOIN csc14.fault_bit fb ON (t.fault_mask >> fb.bit) & 1 = 1
	UNION ALL SELECT NULL, 'none active', '-', '-', t.freshness FROM t WHERE t.fault_mask = 0
	ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Mode over time
panels.description: Operating mode from each telemetry snapshot (last value per bucket).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, (array_agg(mode_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "mode", (array_agg(motion_state_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "motion"
	  FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."mode", d."motion"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wheel speed (measured) and cruise setting
panels.description: Measured left/right wheel speeds from the encoders (mm/s). The cruise SETTING is quantised to 10 mm/s and is not a per-wheel target. NULL (gap) = no encoder data.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, avg(speed_l_mms) AS "left wheel", avg(speed_r_mms) AS "right wheel", (array_agg(cruise_set_mms ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "cruise setting"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."left wheel", d."right wheel", d."cruise setting"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distance since boot (odometer)
panels.description: Newest odometer (cm, saturates at 65535 = 655 m).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(odometer_cm / 100.0, 2) AS "metres" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Commands
panels.description: Source of the running motion command and whether one is active.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((motion_source_label)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((motion_source_label)::text, '-') END AS "source", CASE WHEN cmd_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'none' END AS "command" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: IR sensors (car's real sides; BLACK = over the line)
panels.description: Physical left/right with IR_SIDES_MIRRORED = 1 (drv_ir.h): left = GP27 (also the barcode sensor), centre = GP6, right = GP2. CSC14_IR_SIDES_MIRRORED must match the flashed firmware.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, (array_agg(CASE WHEN ir_left THEN 'BLACK' ELSE 'white' END ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "left (GP27)", (array_agg(CASE WHEN ir_centre THEN 'BLACK' ELSE 'white' END ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "centre (GP6)", (array_agg(CASE WHEN ir_right THEN 'BLACK' ELSE 'white' END ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "right (GP2)"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."left (GP27)", d."centre (GP6)", d."right (GP2)"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tracking state and line position
panels.description: Line state (ON_LINE / SEARCHING / LOST / UNKNOWN = not calibrated) and line position named after the car's real sides.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, (array_agg(line_state_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "state", (array_agg(line_pos_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "position"
	  FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."state", d."position"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Steering request (+ = turn right)
panels.description: Steering the line follower asks Motion Control for (-63..63, motor convention: + = clockwise). 0 while not steering.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, avg(steer) AS "steer"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."steer"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last barcode
panels.description: Newest snapshot. "mapped to" is the navigation MAPPING of the symbol; telemetry v1 does not report whether the turn was executed. The default map is empty (nav_map.c).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((coalesce(bc_symbol, '(none)') || ' ' || bc_result_label)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((coalesce(bc_symbol, '(none)') || ' ' || bc_result_label)::text, '-') END AS "symbol / result",
	  coalesce(nav_label, 'no mapping') AS "mapped to", bc_state_label AS "decoder" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Barcode reads (robot events)
panels.description: One row per BARCODE event; counters in telemetry are modulo 64.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", message FROM csc14.event
	WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) AND kind = 'BARCODE' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: IMU
panels.description: IMU status and motion class (LSM303DLHC: accelerometer + magnetometer, no gyroscope).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((imu_status_label)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((imu_status_label)::text, '-') END AS "status", motion_class_label AS "motion", CASE WHEN tilt THEN 'TILT' ELSE 'level' END AS "tilt", CASE WHEN collision THEN 'COLLISION' ELSE 'none' END AS "collision" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pitch and roll
panels.description: Degrees; pitch nose-up +, roll right-side-down +. Gap = invalid sample.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, avg(pitch_deg) AS "pitch", avg(roll_deg) AS "roll"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."pitch", d."roll"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Turn rate (IMU, + = left / counter-clockwise)
panels.description: Change of the magnetometer heading over 200 ms (no gyroscope on the LSM303DLHC). Invalid while the magnetometer overflows. Motor magnets disturb it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, avg(yaw_rate_ccw_dps) AS "turn rate CCW+"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."turn rate CCW+"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heading: encoder (+ clockwise) vs IMU magnetometer (+ counter-clockwise)
panels.description: Two independent estimates with OPPOSITE sign conventions, both relative to their own start: encoder heading from wheel travel (2 deg steps), IMU heading from the magnetometer relative to calibration. They are not expected to agree in sign.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, (array_agg(heading_enc_cw_deg ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "encoder (CW+)", (array_agg(heading_imu_ccw_deg ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "IMU (CCW+)"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."encoder (CW+)", d."IMU (CCW+)"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tilt, collision, motion class
panels.description: From each snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, (array_agg(motion_class_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "motion class", (array_agg(CASE WHEN tilt THEN 'TILT' ELSE 'level' END ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "tilt", (array_agg(CASE WHEN collision THEN 'COLLISION' ELSE 'none' END ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "collision"
	  FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."motion class", d."tilt", d."collision"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Highest hump (selected run / time range)
panels.description: Maximum of the individual humps received in the selection (FR6). Not the robot's since-boot maximum, which can include humps from before the run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT max(height_mm) AS "highest hump", count(*) AS "humps",
	  count(*) FILTER (WHERE height_mm IS NULL) AS "without height"
	FROM csc14.hump WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid)

panels.title: Robot hump counters (newest snapshot)
panels.description: Since ROBOT BOOT, 2 mm steps: last height, highest, count (4 bits, saturates at 15: after that the robot sends no HUMP events).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hump_last_mm AS "last (mm)", hump_max_boot_mm AS "highest since boot (mm)",
	  hump_count || CASE WHEN hump_count = 15 THEN ' (saturated)' ELSE '' END AS "count",
	  CASE WHEN hump_active THEN 'measuring' ELSE 'idle' END AS "hump" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Individual humps
panels.description: detected_by: robot_event / telemetry (count change) / max_increase or last_change (after the counter saturated); "+" joins two sources of the same hump.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", height_mm AS "height (mm)", count_after AS "robot count",
	  max_boot_mm AS "highest since boot (mm)", detected_by FROM csc14.hump WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid)
	ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Ultrasonic range
panels.description: "No echo" (nothing within 4 m) is drawn as a dashed line at 4 m. Forward range only while the servo is centred and ranging (avoidance IDLE, STOPPING, EXECUTING, SEARCHING, ALIGNING, FAILED). During COARSE/FINE scans the value is a sample at an unknown servo angle (not transmitted); during PLANNING it is held.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, avg(us_forward_mm) AS "forward range", max(CASE WHEN us_no_echo AND us_context = 'forward' THEN 4000 END) AS "no echo: clear beyond 4 m", avg(us_dist_mm) FILTER (WHERE us_context = 'scan_sweep') AS "scan sample (angle unknown)"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."forward range", d."no echo: clear beyond 4 m", d."scan sample (angle unknown)"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avoidance phase and outcome
panels.description: avoid_state and the outcome of the last avoidance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint AS k, (array_agg(avoid_state_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "phase", (array_agg(avoid_outcome_label ORDER BY received_at DESC))[1] AS "last outcome"
	  FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / $__interval_ms)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS time, d."phase", d."last outcome"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest range
panels.description: Newest snapshot with what the value means right now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN now() - received_at > interval '5 seconds' THEN 'STALE ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - received_at)) || ' s: ' || coalesce((CASE WHEN us_no_echo THEN 'clear (> 4 m)' WHEN us_dist_mm IS NULL THEN us_result_label ELSE us_dist_mm || ' mm' END)::text, '-') ELSE coalesce((CASE WHEN us_no_echo THEN 'clear (> 4 m)' WHEN us_dist_mm IS NULL THEN us_result_label ELSE us_dist_mm || ' mm' END)::text, '-') END AS "range", us_context AS "meaning", avoid_state_label AS "phase" FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Last obstacle profile
panels.description: Newest snapshot that carries a profile. "none since boot" = the profile words are still zero. Clearance "at least" = beyond the 2.54 m range of the field.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", obst_width_mm AS "width (mm)", obst_bearing_deg AS "bearing (deg, + right)",
	  clear_left_mm || CASE WHEN clear_left_at_least THEN '+' ELSE '' END AS "clear left (mm)",
	  clear_right_mm || CASE WHEN clear_right_at_least THEN '+' ELSE '' END AS "clear right (mm)",
	  avoid_side_label AS "side chosen"
	FROM csc14.v_telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND profile_reported ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Avoidance outcomes
panels.description: Robot OBSTACLE events (success, cleared, failure with reason) and failures the backend saw in telemetry (the v1 firmware sends no event for a failure).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", origin, severity, message FROM csc14.event
	WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) AND kind IN ('OBSTACLE', 'AVOID_FAILED') ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Frames received per second (10 s average)
panels.description: Telemetry should be 2/s and heartbeats 1/s while the robot is online; 0 = nothing received (outage or robot off).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint AS k, count(*) / 10.0 AS "telemetry"
	  FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * 10000 / 1000.0) AS time, coalesce(d."telemetry", 0) AS "telemetry"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM received_at) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint AS k, count(*) / 10.0 AS "heartbeat"
	  FROM csc14.heartbeat WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * 10000 / 1000.0) AS time, coalesce(d."heartbeat", 0) AS "heartbeat"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Lost frames and robot counters
panels.description: Telemetry frames missing by sequence number in the selection (unknown = gaps too long to count), and the robot's own saturating counters in the newest snapshot.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(seq_gap), 0) FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid)) AS "missing telemetry",
	  (SELECT count(*) FROM csc14.event WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) AND kind = 'TELEMETRY_GAP' AND data->>'exact' = 'false') AS "unknown-length gaps",
	  t.tlm_dropped AS "robot queue drops (sat. 255)", t.rx_rejected AS "commands rejected (sat. 255)"
	FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN (SELECT tlm_dropped, rx_rejected FROM csc14.telemetry WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring}
	  ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1) t ON true

panels.title: Backend: buffer and write latency
panels.description: Rows waiting for PostgreSQL and the 95th percentile of frame-received -> row-committed latency, from csc14.ingest_health.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM at) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint AS k, max(queue_bulk + queue_priority) AS "buffered rows", max(latency_p95_ms) AS "write p95 (ms)"
	  FROM csc14.ingest_health WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1),
	s AS (SELECT generate_series(floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint,
	  floor(extract(epoch FROM $__timeTo()::timestamptz) * 1000 / 10000)::bigint) AS k)
	SELECT to_timestamp(s.k * 10000 / 1000.0) AS time, d."buffered rows", d."write p95 (ms)"
	FROM s LEFT JOIN d USING (k) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rejected frames
panels.description: Frames that failed validation (length, CRC, version, type, field range). They never reach the measurement tables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", topic, reason, detail, length, encode(frame, 'hex') AS frame
	FROM csc14.rejected_frame WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Events (newest first; time = backend receive time, not the physical event time)
panels.description: origin robot = event frame from the robot; server = derived by the backend from telemetry or time; bus = command seen on the broker. Events are derived from 500 ms snapshots on the robot, so very short changes can be missing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "received", origin, severity, kind, message FROM csc14.event
	WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (${run:sqlstring} = 'all' OR run_id = (CASE WHEN ${run:sqlstring} = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE ${run:sqlstring} END)::uuid) ORDER BY received_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Runs (click a name to show that run)
panels.description: Summary from what the backend received during each run; "notes" says why a figure may be incomplete.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name, run_id::text AS run_id, started_at AS "started", ended_at AS "ended", duration_s AS "duration (s)",
	  tlm_frames AS "frames", tlm_missing_known AS "missing", humps, hump_max_mm AS "highest hump (mm)",
	  distance_m AS "distance (m)", avoid_success AS "avoid ok", avoid_failed AS "avoid failed",
	  collisions, array_to_string(notes, '; ') AS notes,
	  (extract(epoch FROM started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS from_ms,
	  (extract(epoch FROM coalesce(ended_at, now())) * 1000 + 5000)::bigint AS to_ms
	FROM (SELECT run_id AS rid FROM csc14.run WHERE robot_id = ${robot:sqlstring} AND source = ${source:sqlstring} ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50) r
	CROSS JOIN LATERAL csc14.run_summary(r.rid) ORDER BY started_at DESC
